description:
## Issue summary

React Native (Expo) mobile flows for Daily Revalidation mobile with offline-safe behaviour.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-05.02 (Execution order: 7)
**Layer:** MOB
**Priority:** Medium (3)

## Positive test cases

- Core workflow usable offline with queued sync
- Auth tokens stored securely
- Offline changes reconcile without data loss
- UI reflects connectivity state clearly

## Negative test cases

- Authoritative data stored only in SQLite
- Sync overwrites newer local changes silently
- Crash on network loss mid-submit

## Acceptance criteria

- Mobile screens implemented for sprint scope
- Offline queue + sync tested
- TypeScript lint passes

## Definition of Done

- Expo app runs on iOS/Android simulator
- Offline scenario manually verified
- No secrets in mobile bundle

---

## Existing notes

Mobile (React Native) implementation for **SP-05.02 — Daily Revalidation**.

**Functional requirements:** FR-MDP-005 to FR-MDP-008

## Screens

* Daily Inspection
* Permit Continuation
* Permit Suspension
* Extension Request

## Capabilities

* Offline inspections
* Camera evidence capture
* Digital signatures
* Synchronisation of inspection records
